accepted_correction: The distinct canonical environment-variable and HTTP field-name grammars and paired consumer controls satisfy NODE-008's requested correction.

decisive_finding.cause: Public DNS validation recognizes only four-label all-decimal IPv4 literals. Alternative numeric IPv4 forms such as 127.1 and 0177.1 therefore enter supported HTTPS URL and author-email authority even though common networking stacks can resolve them as local or ambiguous IP addresses.

corrective_scope: Replace the ad hoc numeric-host decision with one bounded standards-aware authority classifier that distinguishes public DNS names from canonical and alternative numeric IP forms.
Reject decimal, leading-zero, hexadecimal, single-integer, shortened, canonical IPv4, bracketed IPv6, and other ambiguous numeric authorities before supported URL or email acceptance.
Retain valid public DNS, port, path, query, fragment, URL userinfo, reserved suffix, key-grammar, prompt, metadata, MCP shape, and package reachability behavior.
Add unit and paired N02/N04 controls for alternative numeric authorities, then run 16-job focused, full distribution, inventory, and all-target checks before exact freeze and rereview.
claim_ceiling: N04 environment/header semantics are corrected, but complete canonical manifest semantics and all package/install/discovery/runtime claims remain unaccepted. N04 closure, readiness, release, and completion remain withheld.
no_claim_statement: This decision does not claim N04 completion, readiness, release, or goal completion.
